answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method using four datasets that encompass diverse and challenging reasoning tasks presented in two formats. Specifically, MATH (Hendrycks et al.) and GSM8K (Cobbe et al., 2021) focus on arithmetic reasoning with open-ended formats, while MATHQA (Amini et al., 2019) presents math problems in a multiple-choice format. CSQA (Talmor et al., 2019), on the other hand, features multiple-choice commonsense reasoning tasks.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance using four key metrics: accuracy (ACC), attack success rate (ASR), modification success rate (MSR) and detection rate.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, GPT-4o was employed to classify whether the input prompt had been attacked by analyzing the corresponding output solutions.

answer_4.quote: To closely simulate real-world scenarios, we conducted a rigorous human evaluation study involving 20 PhD students in computer science.
answer_4.guideline: instructed each evaluator to spend no more than 10 seconds on each solution, emphasizing the coherence of the Chain of Thought (CoT) rather than the correctness of the reasoning and calculations.
